value.description: The expression that generates the value of the `EnvVar`. Within the `Expr`, `this` refers to a `ImplLanguage.Runtime.Context` created for the `Runtime` the `EnvVar` lives upon.

action.description:
This specifies how we modify the environment variable
REPLACE: replace the existing value with output from `value`
        "MY_ENVVAR":"A" becomes "MY_ENVVAR":"B"
APPEND: add the output from `value` to the end of the existing values
        "MY_ENVVAR":"A" becomes "MY_ENVVAR":"A" + divider + "B"
PREPEND: add the output from `value` to the start of the existing values
        "MY_ENVVAR":"A" becomes "MY_ENVVAR":"B" + divider + "A"
INHERIT_FROM_JVM: inherit the value from JVM
        "PATH" becomes JVM "PATH"

title: Type used to define environment variables for a Runtime
name: ImplLanguage.Runtime.EnvVar
